title: ExecutionRequest v1
description: What an Execution agent is given for one attempt. AGENT_CONTRACTS section 7.3. lockedRefs exists because a user may pin a version this stage must respect rather than regenerate, and fixIssueIds because section 10.2's FIX mode re-runs against specific findings rather than from scratch. Both are supplied by the runtime from the database; the agent cannot add to either.

task.description: The stage's instruction to the agent. It comes from the skill and the stage's own configuration, never from a document.

inputRefs.description: The upstream versions this stage reads, by reference. The agent fetches them through read tools so the runtime can record what was actually read.

lockedRefs.description: Things the user pinned, which this stage must not rewrite.

fixIssueIds.description: The review issues a FIX attempt must address. Empty for a first attempt and for REDO.

idempotencyKey.description: Identifies this attempt so a replayed command does not produce a second version (PRD FR-100's idempotency requirement).
